name: Firefighting Sim 🚒
desc:
🚒 Be a firefighter! Answer 911 calls, race your fire truck through Oak Ridge with sirens blaring, and battle fires that spread for real, in first person with your crew.

Someone's still inside. Go get them. 🔥

🚨 20+ fire trucks: engines, ladder towers, tankers, brush trucks, rescue ambulances & chief cars. Wail, yelp, and pull the air horn cord!
🪓 Force doors with axes & chainsaws, throw ladders, stretch hose lines, mask up in the smoke
🐕 Search burning buildings with your K9 partner
🏠 House, apartment & office fires, brush fires, car fires... and plane crashes at the airport ✈️
⛈️ Lightning storms, rain, day & night
🎖️ Rank up from Recruit to Fire Chief: grade your calls, earn badges, daily challenges & leaderboards
🎮 Play on PC, mobile & console with full controller support

The fire rescue simulator where every call is different.

FREE PRIVATE SERVERS!

Fight fires, have fun, be safe! 👍 Like & ⭐ Favorite for updates!
